application.prioritized_hazard_and_impact: Fiji communities face severe cyclone winds, flooding and damage to homes and essential services.
application.risks_selected_protocols: The protocol prioritizes exposed communities using forecast information and agreed vulnerability criteria.
application.selected_early_actions: Selected actions include early warning, shelter support, WASH items and protection measures.
application.overall_objective_intervention: Reduce the humanitarian effects of a severe cyclone through timely and accountable early action.
application.potential_geographical_high_risk_areas: Forecast-exposed communities in Fiji identified through the activation protocol.
application.assisted_through_operation: Targeted households receive warnings, essential items and locally coordinated support before impact.
application.selection_criteria: Selection prioritizes forecast exposure, vulnerability and limited capacity to prepare independently.
application.trigger_statement: The EAP activates when the agreed cyclone forecast threshold is reached.
application.trigger_threshold_justification: The threshold provides actionable lead time while maintaining sufficient forecast confidence.
application.next_step_towards_full_eap: Continue evidence collection and develop the expanded Full EAP trigger model.
